description: This file defines the helper class `DateTimeHelper`, which provides methods for creating and manipulating PHP DateTime objects, particularly for calendar synchronization tasks. It includes functions for converting various input types into DateTime instances and detecting timezone information in date strings.

classes.name: DateTimeHelper
classes.description: Helper class for DateTime creation and manipulation in Calendar synchronization.

methods.name: createDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime instance from the given input, which can be a string, timestamp, or null. Returns null if input is invalid or empty.

methods.name: isTimezoneAwareString
methods.description: Checks whether a date string contains explicit timezone information.
